implementation.identity: TrainingInputs allocates a unique monotonic environment UID before emission, keeps planned/offer epochs and complete immutable requests, and FIFO-matches each actual Valid-only beat including identical payloads. It never guesses a tag from target, PC or returned payload.
implementation.actual_input: Compare the complete four-way metadata, PC pair, all eight valid/sparse resolve lanes and every active branch field against independent expected_mbtb_feedback, not the driver's encoder. A mismatch latches before advancing the independent model and remains sticky through finish.
implementation.edge: DriveStable samples pre-edge reset-done output only. Driven inputs are captured at actual RisingEdge, then consumed at the next DriveStable; record the original physical edge tick, not the later model tick. A preview withdrawn before acceptance cannot become a phantom input.
implementation.terminals: Accepted/local-drained, reset-cancelled, reset-filtered, initialization-filtered, disabled-filtered and cancelled-before-offer are distinct. Cancelling Python emission does not cancel an already accepted hardware obligation. Delayed observation at or before the cancellation tick remains valid; future offers cannot consume cancelled equal-payload plans.
implementation.finish: Check exact declared UID and terminal sets, states and times in addition to actual/native and model quiescence. No automatic functional input pays a debt. Local-drained is isolated training completion, not FTQ retirement.
implementation.call_chain: Normal train/burst, cleanup dirty/clean, first-clear collision and reset-lifetime acceptance-only issue all use the same planned-input service. Reset-lifetime no longer sends raw driver payload outside the plan.
implementation.drain_regression: Dispatch already-ready input-tail tasks under Execution.paused rather than advancing a gratuitous edge. Keep the original pipeline completion assertions, continuous monitor and raw SDK observation accounting unchanged.
implementation.metadata_limit: Metadata is still explicitly a declared upstream input. This change does not certify genuine lookup metadata ancestry, full FTQ reachability or all lookup/response epoch linkage. Those remain required work.
